name: cloud-architecture-work
description: Author, validate and render canonical cloud architecture models to SVG and PNG on this Mac, for private personal use.

interface.longDescription: Turns an architecture request into a versioned JSON model, checks it against provider catalogs and placement rules, and draws one view at a time to SVG and PNG with a controlled local Graphviz renderer. Covers AWS, Azure, GCP, Huawei Cloud, on-premises and detailed Kubernetes. Runs on this Mac. No Docker, central server or extra API key. For private personal use only, because its Huawei Cloud icons have no cleared rights.
defaultPrompt: Draw an AWS three-tier web architecture
Draw a GKE app with Ingress, Service and storage
Check that this plugin's runtime is ready
